subject: math.MG
name: Cartan–Hadamard theorem for CAT(0) spaces
statement: The universal cover of a complete connected locally CAT(0) length space, with its lifted length metric, is a CAT(0) space. CAT(0) means that geodesic triangles are no thicker than their Euclidean comparison triangles.

subject: math.MG
name: Gromov compactness theorem for metric spaces
statement: A family of nonempty compact metric spaces is relatively compact in Gromov–Hausdorff distance if their diameters are uniformly bounded and, for every ε > 0, every space can be covered by at most N(ε) balls of radius ε for a bound independent of the space.

subject: math.MG
name: Gromov–Hausdorff metric theorem
statement: Gromov–Hausdorff distance is a metric on the isometry classes of nonempty compact metric spaces. In particular, two such spaces have distance zero if and only if they are isometric.

subject: math.MG
name: Kuratowski embedding theorem
statement: Every metric space X embeds isometrically into the Banach space of bounded real-valued functions on X. With a fixed base point x₀, an embedding sends x to the function z ↦ d(x,z) − d(x₀,z).

subject: math.MG
name: Hopf–Rinow theorem for length spaces
statement: Every complete locally compact length space is proper, meaning its closed bounded subsets are compact, and any two points can be joined by a geodesic realizing their distance.

subject: math.MG
name: Arzelà–Ascoli theorem
statement: For continuous maps from a compact metric space to a metric space, an equicontinuous family whose values at every point have compact closure has compact closure in the uniform metric.

subject: math.MG
name: Rademacher's theorem
statement: Every Lipschitz map from an open subset of Euclidean n-space to Euclidean m-space is differentiable at almost every point with respect to Lebesgue measure.

subject: math.MG
name: Kirszbraun extension theorem
statement: An L-Lipschitz map from a subset of a real Hilbert space into another real Hilbert space extends to the whole source Hilbert space with the same Lipschitz constant L.

subject: math.MG
name: McShane extension theorem
statement: Every real-valued L-Lipschitz function f on a nonempty subset A of a metric space extends with the same Lipschitz constant to the whole space. One extension is x ↦ inf over a ∈ A of f(a) + Ld(x,a).

subject: math.MG
name: Blaschke selection theorem
statement: Every sequence of nonempty compact convex subsets of Euclidean n-space contained in a fixed bounded set has a subsequence converging in Hausdorff distance to a nonempty compact convex set.

subject: math.MG
name: Brunn–Minkowski inequality
statement: For nonempty compact subsets A and B of Euclidean n-space, the nth root of the Lebesgue measure of their Minkowski sum A + B is at least the sum of the nth roots of their measures.

subject: math.MG
name: Euclidean isoperimetric inequality
statement: If E ⊆ Euclidean n-space, n ≥ 2, has finite positive volume and finite perimeter, then its perimeter is at least nωₙ¹⁄ⁿ times its volume to the power (n−1)/n, where ωₙ is the volume of the unit ball. Equality holds exactly for balls, up to sets of measure zero.

subject: math.MG
name: Toponogov comparison theorem
statement: In a complete Riemannian manifold with sectional curvature at least k, each minimizing geodesic triangle has angles at least those of the triangle with the same side lengths in the simply connected constant-curvature-k surface. For k > 0, require the triangle perimeter to be less than 2π/√k.

subject: math.MG
name: Reshetnyak gluing theorem
statement: Gluing two complete CAT(0) spaces along isometric nonempty closed convex subsets produces a CAT(0) space with the induced length metric.

subject: math.MG
name: Metric projection theorem for CAT(0) spaces
statement: For every nonempty closed convex subset C of a complete CAT(0) space, each point has a unique nearest point in C. The map sending a point to this nearest point is 1-Lipschitz.

subject: math.MG
name: Cartan fixed-point theorem for CAT(0) spaces
statement: A group acting by isometries on a complete CAT(0) space has a global fixed point whenever one of its orbits is bounded.

subject: math.MG
name: Mazur–Ulam theorem
statement: Every surjective isometry between real normed vector spaces is affine. If the isometry sends zero to zero, it is real-linear.

subject: math.MG
name: Dvoretzky's theorem
statement: For every infinite-dimensional real Banach space, positive integer n, and ε > 0, there is an n-dimensional subspace linearly isomorphic to Euclidean n-space with the product of the operator norms of the isomorphism and its inverse at most 1 + ε.

subject: math.MG
name: John's ellipsoid theorem
statement: Every convex body K in Euclidean n-space has a unique maximum-volume inscribed ellipsoid E. If c is the center of E, then K ⊆ c + n(E−c); when K is centrally symmetric, the factor n can be replaced by √n.

subject: math.MG
name: Bishop–Gromov volume comparison
statement: For a complete n-dimensional Riemannian manifold, n ≥ 2, with Ricci curvature at least (n−1)k times the metric, the volume ratio between a radius-r ball and its constant-curvature-k model ball is nonincreasing in r. When k > 0, restrict to 0 < r < π/√k.
